items.title: New Mexico joins federal lawsuit accusing Dollar General of overcharging customers
items.summary: New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez on Friday joined a multistate lawsuit alleging that Dollar General systematically charged customers more at the register than the prices advertised on store shelves. items.title: Dollar General: Piper Sandler bullish, sees steady high-teens EPS growth
items.summary: Investing.com -- Piper Sandler upgraded Dollar General (NYSE: DG) to Overweight from Neutral and raised its price target to $170 per share in a note on Monday, telling investors that the discount retailer has a clear path to high-teens annual earnings growth over the next three years.
